entries.set_purpose: One short both-lead rehearsal preserves the actual supported stance, then a quiet supported bilateral finish. It prepares position awareness while leaving the new unsupported walking exit for its own counted instruction. The unknown-entry route observes quiet standing only.
entries.prior_current_next: Actual OR03 or equivalent supported stance and more recent response → one retained/reduced preparation rehearsal → S1 repeats that actual branch; OR11 retains support while only the independently controlled exit pause may change.
entries.advance_hold_reduce: Keep support side/height, contact, stance depth and hold. Explicit 1/2/3-second ceilings apply to both P1 lead holds and S1; never lengthen a recent smaller hold because D is selected. The separate bilateral finish stays 2 s when eligible.

standard_D.variant: Split-Squat Isometric Hold — supported-bodyweight-mid-range plus supported bilateral finish — explicit orientation composite
standard_D.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2/10. Each lead holds3s. Use light wall contact with the hand on the front-leg side; free hand at hip. No pushing to an end range.
standard_D.notes: One composite cycle:5s entry/setup,3s left-lead hold,5s standing side change,3s right-lead hold,2s return to bilateral base,2s supported soft-knee finish,5s exit to the adjacent queue. These25s include both sides and the bilateral finish; do not repeat the cycle for each side. This is one brief P1 rehearsal, so inter-set rest is not applicable; actual P1-to-P2 gap is calculated in the session clock. Later S1 has its separate 60 s recovery rule.

entries.set_purpose: One counted walking stop preserves approach, gradual braking and the two-foot finish. This is the movement component needed before the later exit; the ordinary side gate is traffic clearance, not an assessed announced redirect.
entries.prior_current_next: Actual OR03 walking/stop record or counted current walking instruction → one straight P2 finish → independently eligible E1 terminal stop or first announced exit. OR11 uses actual separate stop and exit observations.
entries.advance_hold_reduce: Hold the actual 2 m walking approach and 3–4 m finish region; do not introduce a faster approach or directional assessment in preparation.

standard_D.variant: Walk-to-Stick — explicitly authored prerequisite lesson
standard_D.effort_load: Bodyweight, ordinary deliberate walking, about2/10 effort; gradual short braking steps, no jog or abrupt plant.
standard_D.notes: P2 only: one counted straight walking stop, including faults. The 10 s envelope includes approach, gradual braking, 2 s hold and ordinary side-gate clearance; 15 s segregated outside return follows. This side gate is logistics, not an assessed announced exit. E1 has its own separately selected terminal-stop or paused-exit route.

entries.set_purpose: Every listed attempt teaches or retains a complete controlled stop, balanced pause and ordinary walking exit in an early-announced direction. The first opportunity includes the first actual exit instruction; no separate test precedes it. Standard D uses three opportunities with a 2/1 direction split, compressed D and standard L use one per direction, compressed L one selected direction. Smaller recent count caps omit later opportunities.
entries.prior_current_next: Actual OR03 straight-stop/stance and OR06 recent impact/hinge response → held approach plus one explicitly taught announced walking exit → OR11 may blend only an independently repeatable direction at the same geometry by reducing its pause. OR13 still needs independent movement and cue evidence; OR07 attendance supplies neither.
entries.advance_hold_reduce: Keep the actual approach/stop and full 2 s pause while learning the exit. First side is recorded from the actual teaching need; subsequent opportunities alternate. Three means first/opposite/first, two first/opposite, one first only. A missing or unsuitable direction remains unobserved/limited, with no same-day repayment. Actual recent smaller stop counts select the one/two cap. No reduced pause, faster approach, sharper angle, late cue or new loaded strength variant today.

standard_D.variant: Stop, Pause and Announced Walking Exit — proposed composite, retained gentle-jog approach
standard_D.effort_load: Bodyweight; retain the actually controlled gentle jog, about 3/10, with no faster approach. The exit is ordinary walking at about 2/10, with relaxed natural arms; no cutting, sprinting or output contest.
standard_D.notes: One counted complete stop–pause–exit opportunity per set, including faults. The 20 s action and 45 s outside return are planning envelopes, not a forced gait. The 2 s balanced pause precedes the first opening step; a separate quiet 2 s finish follows the 2 m exit. No extra trial, corrective repetition or make-up side.

entries.set_purpose: One combined both-lead supported hold retains knee/hip and trunk control after the exit lesson. It is the knee/unilateral strength role; no additional squat strength set is needed. An unknown-entry branch counts its first high-stance entries within this set.
entries.prior_current_next: Actual OR03 supported mid/high or unknown-entry record and current response → one retained/reduced both-lead set → OR11 retains the actual stance while any pause change is separately justified.
entries.advance_hold_reduce: All ages use the explicit 5 s D / 3 s L reference per lead only if compatible with their actual recent hold. The 1/2/3 s ceilings preserve smaller history in either mode. Keep one combined set, support and depth. A capped P1/S1 route never adds holds elsewhere.

standard_D.variant: Split-Squat Isometric Hold — supported-bodyweight-mid-range
standard_D.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2–3/10; one5s hold per lead with normal breathing, well before shaking/strain. Light wall contact, same declared comfortable depth; no external load.
standard_D.notes: One combined both-side set, not two sets. Two counted holds×5s +10s stand/change lead/support hand +15s total initial setup/controlled entry and final exit = 35s. The hold clock begins only in the assigned position; entry and exit are counted actions, not extra dynamic split-squat repetitions.
